title: Minecraft but the tick speed randomizes!
description: This plugin randomizes the tick speed of the game and the whole server when you enable the plugin with the command /randomizetick true and to disable it you run  /randomizetick true
body:
### Ever got board of the regular **1x tick speed**? Do you just want to **_mess around with the game_**?
 Well now you can! This plugin randomizes the tick speed of the whole server even the players themselfs to do this install the plugin and put it into a version where the /tick command is available! 

 
Next if you have server operator permissions run the command:
/randomizetick true
then the fun begins! The server will now pick random ticks from 1 - 1000 ticks, every 60 seconds!


just to let you know in order to not be kicked for flying then enable allow-flight in your server properties by just changing it to "allow-flight=true"


 to disable the randomized ticks then do
/randomizetick false

**just for credit or so this plugin is really inspired by the yahiamice video called "Minecraft but the Game Speed RANDOMIZES?!"**

his video is listed down below
